name: Hibernal-Glen
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a binary sunset, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Instruments disagree about the signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever controls dark crystals controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
